python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.Stepper(%PARENT%)
account_step = fluentqt.StepperItem("Account", "Basic info")
account_step.state = fluentqt.Stepper.State.Completed
control.addItem(account_step)
control.addItem(fluentqt.StepperItem("Plan", "Choose tier"))
control.addItem(fluentqt.StepperItem("Confirm", "Finish"))
control.setCurrentIndex(1)
control.stepRequested.connect(control.setCurrentIndex)

description.en: Presents application-controlled steps with completion, error and availability states.
description.zh: 展示多步骤任务的步骤序号、完成进度与异常状态。
